meta.title: Enhance devcontainer.json for prebuilds and Azure CLI installation
meta.body_summary: Add GitHub Codespaces prebuild support via updateContentCommand in devcontainer.json, and automate Azure CLI installation in setup_env.sh to reduce manual setup steps and speed up container startup.

perf_labels.notes: Minimal devcontainer environment change with narrative performance claim about Codespaces startup; closed without review or feedback after 6 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At only 5 changed lines across 2 files, this is a trivial edit by absolute volume. As a performance-motivated environment setup PR it is extremely low risk; the closure without merge (and zero review) is inconsistent with the minimal risk, likely due to lack of maintainer engagement.

core_change_summary.description: Added 'updateContentCommand' to devcontainer.json for GitHub Codespaces prebuilds, and added 'curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | sudo bash' to setup_env.sh for Azure CLI update. Executable permission set for the script.
